rationale: The short thesis remains intact as META continues to consolidate near the bottom of its daily range (16.2%) below both the 5-minute 9-EMA ($622.72) and session VWAP ($624.21). Price action over the last five 1-minute bars was rejected again at $622.85, well below our $623.25 invalidation level, showing persistent overhead supply despite strength in the broader market. With over an hour left in the session and relative volume above 3.0x, holding for a test of the $621.36 low and $620.50 target offers the best risk-reward.
